purpose: Record completed source-specific extraction rows for Human Infra domain modeling, converting selected method and biological-mechanism anchors from queue items into audited endpoint, population, uncertainty and transfer-boundary fields without opening calibrated prediction.

scope.selectionRule: Complete method anchors first, then biological mechanism and safety anchors that constrain aging, cancer, reprogramming, immune maintenance and biomarker interpretation before expanding into social, cognitive and infrastructure anchors.
currentLimitations: Only 55 of the 81 queued domain-source tasks are complete.
Rows are field-level source-specific extractions, not full external literature fresh reviews.
Completed rows keep calibrated prediction, individual recommendation and intervention ranking blocked.
Remaining tasks still include social, cognitive, digital-twin, preservation and future-waiting anchors.

sourceAnchorDecisions.transferBoundary: Transfer only as survival-curve and event-time vocabulary. It does not validate domain parameters, prove intervention benefit, or authorize personal prognosis.
Transfer only as hazard vocabulary and covariate-risk positioning. It does not prove causality, personalize risk, or rank interventions by itself.
Transfer only as causal-design discipline for future intervention evaluation. It does not establish that any domain intervention works.
Transfer only as a prediction-reporting and validation checklist. It does not authorize clinical prediction, individual advice or automated action.
Transfer only as mechanism decomposition and variable-discovery vocabulary. It does not prove causality, clinical benefit, longevity effect, or route safety.
Transfer only as historical mechanism vocabulary. It does not authorize intervention claims, biomarker substitution, or subject-level prediction.
Transfer only as cancer-risk and abort-gate vocabulary. It does not prove screening benefit, treatment effect, or quantified cancer hazard.
Transfer only as a cell-state reprogramming foundation. It does not support human anti-aging therapy, lifespan extension, or safe tissue rejuvenation claims.
Transfer only as route-screening vocabulary for partial reprogramming. It does not establish clinical rejuvenation, LEV, or subject-level safety.
Transfer only as immune-aging mechanism and variable vocabulary. It does not support immune-boosting advice, treatment selection, or calibrated risk estimates.
Transfer only as biomarker-risk and observation-process vocabulary. It does not prove mortality reduction, intervention effect, or personal prognosis.
